BiblicalUsage: Athak was one of the places David sent a share of the spoil to, after he recovered everything the Amalekites had taken. It appears only here, in the list of towns that had sheltered him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe David's gift remembered the friends who had stood by him when he had nothing, and a town's name in that list is a mark of honour.
